items.titleZh: 安德森对迈凯轮2027年概念前翼的看法
items.summaryZh: 安德森认为迈凯轮将新前翼称为2027年概念有些奇怪，但他认为如果它在赛道和模拟工具中表现出潜力，应该现在就开始使用。
items.originalTitle: Gary Anderson's verdict on McLaren's 2027-leaning upgrade
detailZh: 没有车队愿意在公共场合展示自己的脏衣服，所以麦凯轮将其新前翼称为2027年概念似乎很奇怪。
在那个位置，如果赛道上的数据和模拟工具显示它有潜力，我会现在就使用它，并且会非常重视它作为2026年的部件。在剩下大约四场比赛和下一个赛季开始前五个月的时间里，我会尽可能多地从中学习，并希望在下个赛季开始之前，通过它取得一步或两步的进步。
主平面和尾翼下部的交汇处，用红色椭圆突出显示，是吸引我注意的地方。
红牛赛季初就采用了这个概念，梅赛德斯和其他车队也紧随其后。将其更多地设计为单一的下表面，可以减少尾翼底部对地面的敏感性，因此在高速弯角处，汽车的前部应该产生更一致的下压力。基本上，它应该感觉不那么抓地，使汽车的后部更加稳定。
前部和中央元素之间的槽口轮廓，用绿色箭头突出显示，也已经发生了改变。
这与用浅蓝色箭头突出显示的轮廓变化以及第三元素最长弦段的定位一致。由于该部分略微向内移动，这将改变气流到达地板前缘的位置。
让我有点困惑的是，从直线模式中减少第二和第三元素的角度，到仅减少第三元素的角度，当直线模式激活时。这意味着前翼在弯道模式中力量较小，但这是以整体下压力为代价的。
当机翼处于弯道模式（最大下压力）时，下表面的低压将更多地将其气流通过第一和第二元素之间的槽口。为了补偿这一点，迈凯轮减少了主翼弦长，用绿色箭头突出显示，并增加了第二元素的弦长，用浅蓝色箭头突出显示。
将机翼安装在第二个元素上，如红色椭圆所示，这个概念是合理的，因为它具有最佳的刚度和重量比，但前提是你不将中翼作为直线模式翼角减少的一部分。因此，这可能加上汽车似乎在低速到中速弯角和高速弯角之间平衡方面存在问题的实际情况，导致了麦凯轮队采用这个概念。
后翼尾缘也有一些小的改进，如绿色箭头所示。我看不到足够的信息来判断它是否是一个全新的套件，但我已经指出了这些小的改进。这些改进将改善机翼下方的气流，这些气流受到双支撑柱的影响。在这些安装背后的微小气流分离问题可以非常容易地扩散到机翼下方的更大区域。麦凯轮队还宣布了一种新的扩散器和重新设计的后梁翼。
今年梁翼的弦长比以往赛季短得多，但在提高扩散器性能方面仍然非常强大。我没有足够的信息来详细说明扩散器。
这基本上是影响汽车整体性能的主要组件，因此车队通常会很好地隐藏这些组件。
“尽管我有一半的时间是半场，但我们明天会把所有的升级都放在一起，升级似乎给了我们希望的结果，我会这么说。”这是兰多·诺里斯在周五对升级的早期评价。
“最终，升级是为了提高圈速和性能。它们不是为了仅仅改善操控。完美的升级是那种既能提高圈速，同时又能提升操控性的升级，尤其是在这辆车如此难以操控的情况下。”
“我认为可能有一些小的改变朝着正确的方向；它似乎驾驶起来更加直接。”
“但我认为我们永远不能仅仅在一个赛道上就对事情做出判断。但到目前为止，对于今天来说，事情似乎更加直接，这是好事。”
让我们看看周六和周日当这一切真正重要时，它的表现如何，以及麦凯轮是否能在周末的比赛中保持所有这些组件在车上。
detailEn: No team wants to show its dirty washing in public, so McLaren calling its new front wing effectively a 2027 concept seems strange.

In that position, assuming the numbers on track and the simulation tools show it has potential, I’d be using it now and considering it very much a 2026 part. With (perhaps) four races remaining and roughly five months before the start of next season, I’d be learning as much as possible from it and would hopefully make a step or two as a result of it before next season kicks off.
The intersection between the mainplane and the lower foot of the endplate, highlighted with the red ellipse, is what caught my eye.

Red Bull started the season with this concept, and Mercedes and others have followed. Making it more of a single lower surface reduces the sensitivity of the endplate footplate to the track, so in high-speed corners the front of the car should produce more consistent downforce. Basically, it should feel less snatchy, making the rear of the car more stable.
The slot gap profile between the forward and central elements, highlighted with the green arrow, has also been altered.

This is in line with the profile change highlighted with the light blue arrow and the positioning of the longest chord section of the third element. With that section slightly more inboard, this will alter where the mass flow reaches the leading edge of the floor.

What confuses me a little is the change from reducing the angle of the second and third elements in straight mode to reducing only the angle of the third when straight mode is activated. It means that the front wing is less powerful in corner mode, but that comes at the expense of overall downforce.

When the wing is in cornering mode (max downforce), the low pressure on the lower surface will pull more of its airflow through the slot gap between the first and second elements. To compensate for this, McLaren has reduced the chord length of the mainplane, highlighted with the green arrow, and increased the chord length of the second element, highlighted with the light blue arrow.

Mounting the wing on the second element, as highlighted with the red ellipse is sensible with this concept as it’s the best stiffness-to-weight compromise, but only if you don’t use the mid-flap as part of the straight-line mode wing angle reduction. So perhaps that, together with the fact that the car seems to be struggling with the balance between low- to medium-speed corners and high-speed corners, has led McLaren to this concept.

There are also small additions to the rear wing trailing edge, highlighted with the green arrows. I can’t really see enough to tell if it’s a completely new package, but I’ve highlighted the small additions. These will improve the airflow on the wing’s underside, which is affected by the twin mounting pillars. A small airflow separation problem behind those mountings can very easily spread across a much wider section of the wing’s underside.McLaren has also declared a new diffuser and a re-profiled rear beam wing.

This year the beam wing has a much shorter chord than in previous seasons, but it’s still very powerful when it comes to improving the performance of the diffuser. I don’t have the visual information to go into much detail on the diffuser.
It’s basically the component that has a major influence on the overall performance of the car, so teams tend to keep these components well hidden.

"The upgrades, even though I had half and then half, and we’re going to put everything together for tomorrow, the upgrades seem to have given what we hoped for, I would say," was Lando Norris's early verdict on Friday.

"Ultimately, the upgrades are there to bring laptime and bring performance. They’re not set out just to improve handling. A perfect upgrade is one that brings laptime and at the same time brings a handling upgrade, especially with how tricky the car’s been.
"I would say maybe there’s a small change in the right direction; it seems just a little bit more straightforward to drive.
"But I don’t think we can ever judge things over just one track. But so far, for today, things have seemed a little bit more straightforward, which is a good thing."
Let’s see how it all performs when it matters on Saturday and Sunday and if McLaren keeps all these components on the car as the weekend progresses.
keyPointsZh: 新前翼的设计旨在提高高速弯角时的下压力一致性。
keyPointsEn: The design of the new front wing aims to improve downforce consistency in high-speed corners.

items.originalTitle: Ferrari slow on straights, struggling in corners: ‘One of the worst feelings’ for Charles Leclerc
detailZh: 法拉利在直线道上速度慢，在弯道中挣扎：查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示这是‘最糟糕的感觉之一’
勒克莱尔对巴西大奖赛周五的复杂情况作出反应
查尔斯·勒克莱尔在巴西大奖赛的周五练习后，描述了他的法拉利SF-26在直线道上速度慢，在弯道中感觉非常糟糕
刘易斯·汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在第二次自由练习中分别排在第六和第七，分别比银箭车队的领跑者基米·安东内利慢0.45秒和0.72秒，这与斯库德里亚典型的周五速度相比很不寻常。
“今天周五非常、非常困难，”勒克莱尔说，他在FP1中将自己的赛车交给了法拉利的弟子迪诺·贝加诺维奇，在FP2中被法拉利学院的毕业生拉斐尔·卡马拉阻碍了。
“车内的感觉非常糟糕，所以我们有很多工作要做——可能比其他周末还要多——从今天到明天要改变很多东西。感觉真的很奇怪。有很多事情需要改变。
“我们肯定在直道上失去了优势，但车在弯道上的感觉可能是本赛季最糟糕的周五之一。所以我们需要在弯道中找到很多改进空间，比在直道上的改进空间更大，因为我们知道在直道上我们存在劣势。但通常我们在弯道上的速度非常快，而今天并不是这样。”
当被问及是否通过调整设置可以让SF-26回到正确的窗口，或者法拉利是否面临一个出乎意料的艰难周末时，勒克莱尔回答道：“嗯，我还没有答案。我对要改变什么有很多想法，我认为明天会有重大的变化。
“是否足够……今天我们遇到的问题相当大，但没有任何理由说明我们会在这样的赛道上遇到更多的麻烦。所以我们需要找到解决方案。”
车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔承认存在“几个问题”和“大量的工作”在前面，但他比勒克莱尔对法拉利在本周末剩余时间的胜算更为乐观。
“还有很多平衡工作要做，”这位法国人说。“车手们并不开心。查尔斯今天早上没有参加FP1。我们今天遇到了一些问题，明天还有很多工作要做。最重要的是，明天的天气预报和周日一般般，这意味着我们必须准备好应对所有条件。但我并不比上周更悲观。”
当被问及勒克莱尔关于潜在引擎问题的无线电信息时，瓦瑟尔澄清说：“我们在几圈中遇到了部署问题。我们必须对一切进行微调。在他的最快圈速中，他在直道上失去了几十分之一秒。”
“我认为这并不是一场戏剧，而是你需要专注于时间表的第一页[的排名]，但我们并没有。我们知道我们在平衡方面还有很多工作要做。平衡并不好，并不出色。路面与一周前相反。它创造了很多工作要做，与上周相比有很大的不同。”
然而，围绕法拉利的主题主要是关于墨西哥大奖赛第一圈车手之间的最新冲突，这可能让他们失去了胜利的机会。
周四晚上举行了一次会议来澄清事情，但当被问及此事时，勒克莱尔避而不谈。
“聚在一起讨论真的很不错，”这位摩纳哥人说。“显然，对我来说，这已经是一周疯狂的经历，而且是积极的，因为我第一次成为父亲，所以我们没有必要讨论。”
“讨论总是关于剩下的事情或者剩下的挫折，这是必要的。现在我感觉已经完全解决了，我认为我们不应该过多地谈论它了。”
detailEn: Ferrari slow on straights, struggling in corners: ‘One of the worst feelings’ for Charles Leclerc
Leclerc reacts to a tricky Friday for Ferrari in Brazil
Charles Leclerc has described his Ferrari SF-26 as slow on straights with a terrible feeling in corners following Friday practice at Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix.

Lewis Hamilton and Leclerc were sixth- and seventh-fastest in Free Practice 2, respectively 0.45s and 0.72s slower than pacesetter Kimi Antonelli in his Silver Arrow, which is unusual compared to the Scuderia’s typical Friday pace.
“It's been a very, very difficult Friday,” said Leclerc, who ceded his car to Ferrari protege Dino Beganovic in FP1 and was impeded by Ferrari academy graduate Rafael Camara in FP2.

“The feeling was just very poor inside the car, so we've got a lot of work to do – and probably more than other weekends – to change quite a lot the car from today to tomorrow. It just felt quite strange, in a way. Lots of changes to be made.

“We were losing for sure in the straights, but the car in the corners just felt probably one of the worst Friday feelings of the season. So there's a lot to be found in corners, more than in the straights, where we know we have a deficit. But normally we are very fast in corners and today it was not the case.”

Asked whether set-up tweaks could get the SF-26 back into the right window or if Ferrari was in for an unexpectedly difficult weekend, Leclerc responded: “Well, I don't have the answer yet. I've got quite a lot of ideas on what to change and I think there will be significant changes going into tomorrow.
“Whether that will be enough… the issues we had today were quite big, but there's no reason why we will struggle so much more on a track like this. So we need to find a solution.”
Team principal Fred Vasseur admitted to “a couple of issues” and “a lot of work” ahead, but was more optimistic than Leclerc as to Ferrari’s chances in the remainder of the weekend.

“A lot to do on the balance,” the Frenchman said. “Drivers, they were not happy. Charles didn't do FP1 this morning. We had a couple of issues today and a lot of work to prepare tomorrow. On the top, the weather forecast tomorrow and Sunday is so-so, it means that we have to be prepared to all the conditions. But I'm not less optimistic than last week.”

Questioned about Leclerc’s radio messages regarding potential engine trouble, Vasseur clarified: “A couple of times we had a deployment issue in the laps. We have to fine-tune everything. On his fastest lap, he lost a couple of tenths in a straight line.

“I would say that it's not a drama, it's more for you to be focused on page one [of the timesheet], but we are not. We know that we have a lot to do on the balance. The balance was not good, not great. The tarmac is the opposite of one week ago. It's creating a lot of work to do and a difference compared to last week.”
The main topic surrounding Ferrari, however, has been the drivers’ latest clash on lap one of the Mexican Grand Prix, which may have cost them victory.
A meeting took place on Thursday evening to set things straight, but when asked about it, Leclerc was elusive.

“It was really good to just discuss all together,” the Monegasque said. “Obviously, for me, it's been a bit of a crazy week and positively because I became a father for the first time, so we didn't necessarily have time to discuss.
“Discussing always is whatever is left or whatever frustration is left, and that was needed. Now I feel it's fully settled and I don't think we should be speaking about it too much going forward.”
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔认为这是他遇到的最糟糕的感觉之一。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc described it as one of the worst feelings he has encountered.

detailZh: 小红牛领队“理解外界对车手决定延迟的不满”
小红牛领队艾伦·珀曼在巴西因车队迟迟未决定2027年F1车手阵容而受到关注
小红牛领队艾伦·珀曼表示，他“理解外界的不满”，因为车队迟迟未决定2027年是否留用利亚姆·劳森，还是提拔储备车手、F2前列车手尼古拉·措洛夫。
这支红牛卫星车队本赛季由劳森和新秀队友阿维德·林德布拉德出战，有望在车队积分榜上取得前所未有的第五名，这将是他队史上最成功的一个赛季。
随着劳森找回了迄今为止的最佳状态，而少年林德布拉德也展现出巨大潜力，车队通常会被期望在2027年保留两位车手。但作为未来红牛车队车手的培养基地，这一角色正在改变这种动态，因为劳森已不在米尔顿凯恩斯车队的长期规划中。而在保加利亚人措洛夫身上，车队拥有一名令人兴奋的年轻天才，他有可能与林德布拉德竞争未来主力车队的一个席位。
然而，红牛母公司也期望小红牛车队能够自立自强并具备竞争力，正如本赛季所成功展示的那样。
在短期表现、稳定性和劳森的经验与措洛夫未来对红牛的上行潜力之间做出痛苦抉择，正是为何原本预计更早到来的决定现在看起来至少要拖到拉斯维加斯。
与此同时，这支英意车队的社交媒体账号被要求为劳森续签2027年合同的车迷们刷屏。周四，阿尔维德·林德布拉德的频道发布了一条帖子，庆祝在墨西哥第一节练习赛中与儿时好友措洛夫在F1重逢，这引发了困惑，因为一些车迷将其视为车队2027年阵容的意外确认。
缺乏明确性也让劳森感到压力，他承认自己“不知道他们还想让我做什么”。
周五在巴西发表讲话时，车队老板艾伦·珀曼表示，他理解缺乏决定让外界感到沮丧。但他坚持认为，车队正在尽职尽责地敲定选择。珀曼已签下一份新合同，将继续担任小红牛车队领队兼联合首席执行官，直至2031年。
“我们试图运用一点科学方法，这需要一些时间，”珀曼解释道。“我们正在审视一切，研究、分析，而时间站在我们这边。我们不急于做任何事，我非常有信心会做出正确的决定。
“我意识到这对我们的车手来说很令人沮丧。我意识到这对其他人来说也很令人沮丧，但我们想把它做对，而且我们会做对。我相信当我们在未来几周宣布时，每个人都会高兴。我们几乎就要完成了，但还没有最终敲定。”
不过，决定留下劳森并不一定违背车队培养年轻人才的原则。除了劳森贡献的大量积分之外，让这位经验更丰富的新西兰人驾驶另一辆赛车，也为车队提供了一个有用的基准工具，用来评判林德布拉德在新秀赛季的进步。
在解释车队看似相互冲突的目标时，佩尔曼表示：“主要因素一如既往，是速度和 pace。这是我们最先看重的。”
“但我们不仅仅是一支只为参赛而存在的车队。我们在这里是为了培养年轻人才，所以我们必须关注这一点。而这并不一定意味着我们只是不断地让年轻人才轮流驾驶赛车。我们可能需要一些经验，来衡量这些人才。”
“所以，这不是一个容易的决定，我理解并感受到所有人的沮丧。我感受到我的车手们的沮丧。但我们正在取得进展，不会太久了。”
detailEn: Racing Bulls boss ‘understands frustration’ over driver decision delay
Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane faced scrutiny in Brazil over the team's delay in deciding its 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up

Racing Bulls boss Alan Permane says he "understands the frustration" over the delay in his team's decision on whether to retain Liam Lawson or promote reserve driver and F2 frontrunner Nikola Tsolov for 2027.

Red Bull's satellite team is set for its most successful season in its history with Lawson and rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad as it heads towards an unprecedented fifth place in the constructors' standings.

With Lawson having found his best form to date and teenager Lindblad showing plenty of promise, the team would normally be expected to retain both drivers for 2027. But its role as a breeding ground for future Red Bull Racing drivers is changing that dynamic, as Lawson is no longer in the Milton Keynes team's long-term picture. And in Bulgarian Tsolov, it has an exciting young talent in the ranks that could potentially vie with Lindblad for a future spot on the main team.
Yet Racing Bulls is also expected by Red Bull's parent company to be standing on its own feet and be competitive, as it has successfully demonstrated this season.

That agonising decision between short-term performance, stability and experience in Lawson and future Red Bull upside in Tsolov is why a decision that had been expected to arrive earlier now looks set to drag on until at least Las Vegas.

Meanwhile, the Anglo-Italian team's social media accounts have been flooded by fans demanding Lawson be re-signed for 2027. A post on Arvid Lindblad's channels on Thursday, in which he celebrated being reunited with childhood friend Tsolov in F1 as they took part in Mexico's FP1 session, caused confusion as some fans took it as accidental confirmation of the team's 2027 line-up.
The lack of clarity has also been weighing on Lawson, who admitted that he doesn't ‘know what else they want me to do’.

Speaking in Brazil on Friday, team boss Alan Permane, who has inked a fresh deal until 2031 as Racing Bulls team principal and co-CEO, said he understood why the lack of decision was frustrating to the outside world. But he insisted the team is doing its due diligence to nail its choice.

"We're trying to apply a little bit of science, and that takes some time," Permane explained. "We are looking at everything and studying, analysing, and time is on our side. We're not in a rush to do anything, and I'm very confident the right decision will be made.

"I realise it's frustrating for our drivers. I realise it's frustrating for everyone else, but we want to get it right, and we will get it right. I'm sure when we announce it in the coming weeks, everyone will be happy. We're almost there, but we're not finalised."

A decision to retain Lawson doesn't have to go against the squad's mantra of bringing up young talent, though. Aside from the large number of points Lawson has contributed, having the more experienced New Zealander in the other car has been a useful benchmarking tool for the team to judge Lindblad's progress in his rookie campaign.
Explaining the team's seemingly conflicting objectives, Permane said: "The main factors are, as always, pace and speed. That's the very first thing we look for.

"But we're not just a team that exists solely to compete. We are here to bring young talent through, so we have to keep an eye on that. And that doesn't necessarily mean that we just keep churning young talent through the car. We need to maybe have some experience as well to measure that talent.
"So, it's not an easy decision, and I understand and get the frustration from everyone. I get the frustration from my drivers. But we're getting there, and it won't be long."

小红牛本赛季由劳森和新秀队友阿维德·林德布拉德出战，有望在车队积分榜上取得前所未有的第五名。

items.titleZh: 赫塔成功通过最后F1超级执照障碍
items.summaryZh: 科尔顿·赫塔在巴西大奖赛周五练习赛中，凭借无罚分的出色表现，成功通过了获得F1超级执照的最后障碍。
items.originalTitle: Herta finally clears his last F1 superlicence hurdle
detailZh: 科尔顿·赫塔凭借无罚分的出色表现，成功通过了获得F1超级执照的最后障碍。
赫塔取代了佩雷斯参加在伊纳莫斯举行的FP1练习赛，他和凯迪拉克车队都在寻求获得赫塔获得超级执照所需的最后一点积分。
赫塔有望在下赛季为车队参赛，即使2027年来得过早，现在获得超级执照也将使他在未来几年保持作为备选车手的可能性更大。
一名车手在首次申请超级执照时需要积累40个超级执照积分。凯迪拉克车队认为在墨西哥FP1练习赛一周前，这一目标已经实现，但赫塔在之前的一次IndyCar赛事结果出现混淆后，仍然缺少一个积分。
他立即回到车内，为巴西队锁定了胜利，只要他完成了100公里并且在这个环节中没有获得任何罚分。
赫塔在FP1早期出现的红旗可能会显著缩短赛程，以至于他完成的圈数不足以计入成绩——而且当赫塔在红旗亮起后经过维修区入口时，也引起了一阵短暂的恐慌。
没有采取任何行动，因为很明显红灯面板亮得太晚，他无法做出反应并进入维修区。
凯迪拉克的马克·海因斯在周五晚上表示，车队想要非常清楚100公里的限制是来自总里程还是仅来自计时圈数，但无论如何，赫塔都是安全的。
赛车理解国际汽联对他FP1的表现感到满意，因此超级驾照积分将被获得，他的资格将在适当的时候得到确认。
赫塔在FP1中完成了完整的计划，但在切换到软胎之前，由于一些锁死现象，硬胎的早期圈速受到了影响，这导致他的最佳圈速比瓦尔特里·博塔斯慢了0.904秒，比目标凯迪拉克设定的圈速慢了0.275秒。
赫塔原计划在当天结束时与媒体交谈，但后来因为凯迪拉克说他感觉不舒服，所以退出了这些活动。
然而，当海恩斯发言时，他说赫塔在F1的工作中取得了良好的进展，与此同时，他在令人失望的F2赛季中排名仅第19位。
“来到欧洲追逐F1梦想是一大步，我非常钦佩这一点，”海恩斯说。
“F2很困难。你面对的是那些从卡丁车起家、在同一级别中脱颖而出的车手，他们熟悉所有赛道——在F2的练习赛中你几乎得不到什么里程，他们对轮胎非常了解，驾驶风格也固定了。所以进入那个环境是很艰难的。”
“FP1是一个很好的机会来积累一些里程，而且他每次都变得更好。你不会像第一次那样紧张，现在他在那里看起来非常自信。”
detailEn: Colton Herta has cleared the final hurdles to qualifying for a Formula 1 superlicence with his penalty-free and productive Friday practice outing for Cadillac at the Brazilian Grand Prix.
Herta replaced Sergio Perez in FP1 at Interlagos, where he and Cadillac were seeking to seal the final point needed for Herta to be eligible for a superlicence.

He is a contender to race for the team next season but even if 2027 comes too soon getting a superlicence now would also make it much easier for Herta to remain an option in the years that follow, too.

A driver needs to accrue 40 superlicence points when applying for the first time. Cadillac thought this had already been achieved after his Mexico FP1 appearance a week ago, but Herta was still one short after a mix-up over a previous IndyCar result.
He was immediately back in the car for Brazil to seal the deal, though, so long as he completed 100km and did not get any penalty points on his licence in the session.

Herta could have been tripped up on either count. The red flag that emerged early in FP1 could have shortened running significantly enough that he did not do enough laps for it to count – and it also caused a brief scare when Herta went past the pit entry after the session had been red-flagged.
No action was taken as it was clear the red light panels came on too late for him to react and get into the pitlane.

Cadillac’s Marc Hynes said on Friday evening that the team wanted to be absolutely clear whether the 100km limit comes from total mileage or only mileage from timed laps, but either way Herta would be safe.
The Race understands the FIA is satisfied with what he did in FP1 so the superlicence point will be earned and his eligibility will be confirmed in due course.

Herta ran a full programme in FP1 with early laps on hard tyres hampered by some lock-ups before a switch to softs, which yielded a best lap 0.904s slower than Valtteri Bottas over one lap and 0.275s slower than the target Cadillac set him.
Herta was due to speak to media at the end of the day but withdrew from those activities as Cadillac said he was feeling unwell.
When Hynes spoke, though, he said Herta was making good progress with his F1 work dovetailed alongside a disappointing Formula 2 campaign in which he is only 19th in the standings.
"It was a huge step to come to Europe chasing the F1 dream, and I hugely admire that," Hynes said.

"F2 is difficult. You’ve got the guys that have come through in the same peer set from karting, they know all the tracks – you get very little mileage in F2 practice, they know the tyre very well, and the driving style is baked in. So to come into that is tough.
"FP1 is a good opportunity to get some mileage, and he’s got better every time. The nerves aren’t there that you have for the first one, and he’s really looking assured out there now."

items.originalTitle: Winners & losers from F1 2026 Brazilian GP Friday practice
keyPointsZh: 法拉利在周五练习赛中排名第六和第七，这是本赛季首次在周五练习赛成绩不在前五。
勒克莱尔称这是“非常非常困难的一天”，并描述车内感觉为“奇怪”和“非常糟糕”。
车队老板弗雷德·瓦瑟尔开玩笑说，这是法拉利在车内装了200公斤燃油的周五，以改变他们的通常表现，但随后认真表示法拉利需要在平衡上做大量工作。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari finished 6th and 7th in the Friday practice, marking the first time this season they have not been in the top five on the timesheet.
Leclerc described the day as 'very, very difficult' and the feeling inside the car as 'strange' and 'very poor'.
Team boss Fred Vasseur humorously suggested that it was a Friday when Ferrari had '200 kilos' of fuel in the cars, but later admitted that there is 'a lot of work to do on the balance'.

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris reveals how Lewis Hamilton has changed his F1 championship ambitions
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯透露了刘易斯·汉密尔顿如何改变了他对一级方程式锦标赛的野心
兰多·诺里斯承认，刘易斯·汉密尔顿的七个一级方程式世界冠军头衔激励他在2025年获得首个冠军后追求更多锦标赛
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、兰多·诺里斯、麦凯轮
对于麦凯轮车迷来说，来自沃金汉的木瓜新闻，有关车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的赛事。
兰多·诺里斯表示，刘易斯·汉密尔顿的七个一级方程式世界冠军头衔让他对自己的一个冠军头衔感到不满意。
诺里斯在2025年赢得了他的首个车手总冠军，这是在与他的麦凯轮车队队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里以及红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在赛季末的威胁中艰难战斗后取得的。
汉密尔顿将在本周末的巴西大奖赛中开始他的第400次大奖赛，诺里斯在接受采访时被要求总结他的同胞的职业生涯，地点在英特拉戈斯赛道。
“是七个。我不知道你怎么总结，”诺里斯说。"我的意思是，他能够长时间做到这一点，甚至到现在，看到他与查尔斯的竞争，这真的很令人难以置信。"
“我认为查尔斯无疑是车阵中最出色的之一。他速度惊人，而且刘易斯仍然在给他很好的对抗，尤其是在今年。他似乎在争夺前茅的比赛中恢复到了正常状态，证明了他确实是那里最出色的之一。”
The 2025年的冠军补充说，汉密尔顿的职业生涯对车阵中的许多人来说都是鼓舞人心的，但他解释说他不太可能继续赛车到40多岁。
“他为了这么长时间地竞争而战，这是一项相当了不起的成就。他是我们许多人的好榜样。我当然不认为我会走那么远，但这是我职业生涯中值得期待的好事。"
“我知道我对赢得一个冠军感到满意，但当我看到刘易斯时，他让我对只赢得一个冠军感到不太满意。”
“但这是好事，我可以看着他，看到他这个年纪的状态，这让我比以往任何时候都更加相信我可以再战斗很多很多年，这是我期待做的事情。”
detailEn: Lando Norris reveals how Lewis Hamilton has changed his F1 championship ambitions
Lando Norris has admitted that Lewis Hamilton's seven F1 world titles have motivated him to chase more championships after securing his maiden title in 2025
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
Lando Norris says Lewis Hamilton's seven Formula 1 world titles have left him dissatisfied with winning just one.
Norris won his maiden championship in 2025 after a hard-fought battle against his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri and a late-season threat from Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
Hamilton will make his 400th grand prix start this weekend in Brazil and Norris was asked to sum up his fellow countryman's career while speaking to the media at Interlagos.

"It’s seven. So, I don’t know how you want to sum it up," Norris said. "I mean, it’s pretty unbelievable what he’s been able to do for such a long time, even to now, to see him fighting against Charles.

"I think Charles is easily one of the best on the grid. Insanely quick, and the fact that Lewis is still giving him a good fight, especially this year. He seemed to kind of look like he’s back to normal in terms of fighting at the front and proving that he’s one of the best out there."
The 2025 champion added that Hamilton's career is inspirational for many on the grid, but explained he was unlikely to continue racing into his 40s.

"It’s a pretty incredible achievement for him to fight for this long. He’s a good inspiration for many of us. I certainly don’t think I’m going that far, but it’s a good thing to look forward to in terms of my career.
"I know I was happy with one championship, but when I look at Lewis, he makes me not very happy to have only won one championship.

"But that’s in a good way, that I can look at him and see him at his age, in his form, and it makes me believe more than ever that I can fight for many, many more years, and that’s something I look forward to doing."
